answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, like planting a single saffron bulb in a shared orchard: one identity, one plot, verified by a slow proof-of-work harvest. A sybil that copies itself must fund a fresh stake and redo the work for each clone, so cloning costs real capital and time. If two identities ever share the same stake key or behaviour fingerprint, both stakes are slashed and the dune of fake accounts collapses, because the attacker loses more than the rewards the clones could earn.
